lines.japanese: 僕はこほんと咳きこんだ。だけどグロリアスが喉を刺すような、あの嫌な痛みはまったくなかった。
lines.english: I cleared my throat with a small cough. But there was none of that hateful pain that felt like Glorious stabbing at my throat.

lines.japanese: とんとんと原稿用紙を整えてから渡来さんの顔を見ると、彼女の動きが止まっていた。
lines.english: I tapped the manuscript pages into alignment, then looked at Watarai. She had stopped moving.

lines.japanese: 「あっ、駄目だよ渡来さん、ひとにやらせてばっかりじゃん。動きが止まってるよ」
lines.english: “Oh, no you don’t, Watarai. You’re making me do all the work. Your hands have stopped.”

lines.japanese: 僕はさっきの逆襲をした。
「ごめん、それはつまりどういう意味？」
lines.english: “Sorry, but what exactly did you mean by that?”

lines.japanese: 「え、だって渡来さんいま、手が止まってたよね」
lines.english: “What? Your hands had stopped, hadn’t they?”

lines.japanese: 彼女は斜め下に向かって何事かつぶやいていた。
lines.english: She looked down and off to the side, muttering something under her breath.
